SMTO-KV-0004 — The agent's note search had no usable search text

GUID: 0245526c-8e0a-40e1-a298-283c18fc59bc
Slug: kv-invalid-query
Domain: KV · Subsystem: kv

What happened

  • The agent searched its task notes, but the search text was empty, longer than 256 characters, or contained a hidden control character. Nothing was searched or changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let the agent continue; it usually retries with proper search text or lists its notes instead. A short search phrase, or a plain list, works where an empty search can't.
  2. If you asked the agent to search its notes, give it a short word or phrase, for example "deadline". Search needs between 1 and 256 characters of real text.

What success looks like

  • The agent returns matching notes, or says none match.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't repeat the same empty or very long search.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Agent KV search rejected a query that is not a string, is empty or whitespace-only, exceeds 256 characters, or contains a NUL character.

What this means

  • Search receives a non-string, empty/whitespace-only query, more than 256 characters or a NUL character. KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.

Why this can happen

  • Search receives a non-string, empty/whitespace-only query, more than 256 characters or a NUL character.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the query itself before changing saved entries or pagination.

How to fix it

  • Send kv__search a non-blank query of 1–256 characters with no NUL character; to enumerate notes, use kv__list with a prefix instead of an empty search.
  • Supply a bounded supported query and valid filter fields.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • A nonempty bounded NUL-free text query passes validation.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
